hierarchy.message: Mardling-Aarseth stability: 93x the critical a_out/a_in=51.20 at the tighter epoch; inner binary 292x inside its Hill radius about the lens; a_in/a_out = 2.11e-04 (point source). Requires 10x margin on the first two, <1e-3 on the third.

outer_orbit_is_static_over_the_observati.message: outer orbit's own GW decay time = 4.00e+07 yr, of which 1.6e-08 elapses before the inner binary merges (require <1e-4, so a_out is fixed); Kozai-Lidov t_KL = 16.1 yr is 24x the time to merger, and further quenched by inner GR precession, t_KL/t_GR = 3.4e+04 (require >100)

quasi_monochromatic_regime.message: 60.2 outer periods before merger (observing 6 of them); fractional freq drift over the observing baseline = 4.02e-02 (require merger>>observing window, drift<5%)

wave_optics_regime_nontrivial.message: w_B=0.309 (require <1, diffractive); Case A band w=61.9 to 777.6 (require >30 throughout, geometric optics)
